fields.Name: IT72 - Startup Mode
fields.Description: Proof of the configurable startup mode ('full' | 'task') against the live process's real @RegisterForStartup registration set (deterministic, no model calls, no fixtures). SM1: a task-mode Startup executes ZERO registered engines while still succeeding and marking startup complete (LocalCacheManager init runs in both modes). SM2: an engine still lazy-loads on demand via its own Config() after the task-mode boot — the first-touch-pays-the-load contract. SM3: a full-mode Startup executes every sync registration, restoring canonical behavior. The bundle's lifecycle Teardown re-runs full mode best-effort so the process always ends in the canonical state.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Task mode executes zero engines; lazy Config still loads on demand; full mode executes every sync registration.
